verdict.rationale: Clara documents card creation via API, virtual cards that are active immediately with no activation step, and per-card limits whose reset periodicity can be set, plus optional merchant, time and day restrictions. Physical card issuance is never explicitly documented; it is only implied by the card-type field. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of physical card issuance and delivery timing, explicit documentation of per-card spend limit amounts, dashboard (non-API) issuance flow for founders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue physical and virtual corporate cards to the team in minutes, each with its own spend limit

citations.quote: `"VIRTUAL"` creates a virtual card, active immediately (no activation step needed).
Create, update, lock/unlock, and delete cards.
`periodicity`: `"MONTHLY"`, `"WEEKLY"`, or `"DAILY"` — determines when the limit resets
Use the Card Configurations API to add time, day-of-week, or merchant category restrictions.
